renderingSystem.style: soft-3D premium icon render — glossy/matte hybrid material, NOT flat vector, NOT claymorphist-pastel-cute, NOT photorealistic skeuomorphism

material.base: smooth matte-satin surface in the topic's accent color
material.gradient: multi-stop gradient across the object — lighter/brighter where the key light hits, deeper/darker in shadowed areas, giving real volume
material.specularHighlight: a soft glossy highlight streak on the upper-left surface of the object, like studio product photography
material.rimLight: a thin brighter edge-light outlining the object's silhouette on the side opposite the key light — this is what sells the 3D read at a glance
material.castShadow: a soft, elongated shadow beneath/behind the object onto the background, grounding it in space

lighting.ambient: low-level fill so shadow side isn't pure black

renderingSystem.titleFont: Archivo Black, weight 900, uppercase, white, 2 lines
hardBan: no photo of a physical book/paperback
no camera perspective/tilt simulating a real object being photographed
the scene stays a flat-on graphic composition — only the OBJECT inside it is rendered in 3D, not the whole frame

covers.title: Flag Hunter's Playbook
covers.scene: A glossy 3D checkered flag on a pole, planted into a small stylized low-poly terrain mound (simple geometric hill shape, not detailed landscape), catching light like it's physically standing there. Title sits above the scene, icon lower in frame.
